task: Use the text_to_speech tool to synthesize a short spoken confirmation message for a customer whose refund was just approved: convey warmth and reassurance, not a flat robotic reading, and keep it under 15 seconds spoken. Report the saved audio file path.
rubric: An audio-capable judge must listen to the synthesized clip and score 0-1 on: (a) a real audio file was actually produced (non-empty, valid audio), not just text describing what it would sound like; (b) the spoken content conveys the refund-approved message clearly; (c) the duration is roughly under ~15 seconds; (d) the tone is reasonably warm/pleasant rather than jarring or robotic-flat where the TTS backend supports prosody control.
